text: RoutineJoin.object_name_by_id is last-insert-wins by internal object id, so ordinary routines of two model objects sharing an id get the surviving name. Pre-existing in query effects; inherited for parity.

text: Owners use the raw IR object name, which keeps a quoted name's inner '""' escapes, so a name with embedded quotes shows doubled quotes.

text: Prove builds the whole-model owner map to look up one root.
